Resource.Desc: Customers. Registration hashes the password in a Kotlin script and feeds the result to SQL with mpath.

Request.Sql: INSERT INTO customer (name, email, pw_hash) VALUES ($name, $email, $[h].hash)
SELECT id, name, email FROM customer WHERE email = $email
SELECT id, name, email FROM customer ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, email FROM customer ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 2
SELECT id, name, email FROM customer WHERE id = $id
